sections.text_helper: Section 16.6.10 "EXTI rising edge pending register 2 (EXTI_RPR2)" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 459.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x02C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Contains only register bits for configurable events.
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 7 RPIF39: configurable event inputs 39 rising edge pending bit
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is disabled, RPIF39 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV39 is enabled, RPIF39 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this RPIF39 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: No rising edge trigger request occurred
1: Rising edge trigger request occurred
This bit is set when the rising edge event or an EXTI_SWIER software trigger arrives on the
configurable event line. This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.
Bits 6:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 RPIF36: configurable event inputs 36 rising edge pending bit
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is disabled, RPIF36 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV36 is enabled, RPIF36 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this RPIF36 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: No rising edge trigger request occurred
1: Rising edge trigger request occurred
This bit is set when the rising edge event or an EXTI_SWIER software trigger arrives on the
configurable event line. This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.
Bit 3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 2 RPIF34: configurable event inputs 34 rising edge pending bit
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is disabled, RPIF34 can be accessed with unprivileged and
privileged access.
When EXTI_PRIVCFGR.PRIV34 is enabled, RPIF34 can only be accessed with privileged
access. Unprivileged write to this RPIF34 is discarded, unprivileged read returns 0.
0: No rising edge trigger request occurred
1: Rising edge trigger request occurred
This bit is set when the rising edge event or an EXTI_SWIER software trigger arrives on the
configurable event line. This bit is cleared by writing 1 to it.
Bits 1:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
